title: mail-server: MemoryBackend Email create skips Thread and counts
description: Found in JMAP-u6c5. MemoryBackend::import_email creates or extends the Thread object, bumps Thread state, updates Mailbox totalEmails/unreadEmails/totalThreads/unreadThreads and the Message-ID index. MemoryBackend::create_email (like create_object::<Email> before it) stores only the Email row and its state. A created Email therefore has no Thread object and does not move Mailbox counts (RFC 8621 2, 3). Fix: share import_email's insert step with create_email.
